focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须完成碳数据合规闭环
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。中国钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥等对欧出口企业须在过渡期内完成产品嵌入碳排放的申报与核查，否则将面临无法清关或高额罚金。实务上，企业应尽快建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，与欧盟进口商确认数据接口，并关注欧盟委员会即将发布的最终核查规则。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.11.12
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Must Close Carbon Data Compliance Loop
focus.summary_en: The EU's CBAM transitional period ends in late 2026, with definitive taxation starting in 2027. Chinese exporters of steel, aluminium, cement and fertilisers to the EU must complete embedded emissions reporting and verification during the transition or face customs clearance blocks and heavy penalties. In practice, companies should establish product-level carbon footprint accounting, align data interfaces with EU importers, and monitor the European Commission's forthcoming final verification rules.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认与执行中国法院商事判决，跨境债权实现路径再拓宽
case.summary: 近期新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）依据《选择法院协议公约》及中新司法合作备忘录，承认一起中国法院作出的商事金钱判决。该案确立：若双方在合同中明确约定中国法院管辖且判决符合新加坡公共政策，SICC可予以承认执行。对中国出海企业而言，这意味着在跨境交易中约定中国法院管辖并保留完整送达与程序记录，可显著提升债权实现的确定性。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭公报 · 2026.10
case.title_en: SICC Recognises and Enforces Chinese Commercial Judgment, Broadening Cross-Border Debt Recovery
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised a Chinese monetary judgment under the Hague Choice of Court Convention and the China-Singapore judicial cooperation memorandum. The ruling confirms that where parties expressly choose Chinese court jurisdiction and the judgment complies with Singapore public policy, SICC may recognise and enforce it. For Chinese outbound enterprises, this means stipulating Chinese court jurisdiction and maintaining robust service and procedural records can significantly enhance certainty in debt recovery.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动负面清单再扩容，涉外企业数据出境合规路径更清晰
policy.summary: 广东省网信办近期更新粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动负面清单，新增金融、医疗、汽车等领域的数据项，同时明确清单外数据可经标准合同或安全评估后自由流动。对在大湾区运营的涉外企业而言，应尽快对照清单梳理数据资产，优先采用标准合同路径完成出境合规，并关注香港、澳门与内地数据互认机制的衔接。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: GBA Cross-Border Data Negative List Expanded, Clarifying Data Export Compliance for Foreign-Related Firms
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong recently updated the negative list for cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area, adding data categories in finance, healthcare and automotive sectors, while clarifying that data outside the list may flow freely via standard contracts or security assessments. Foreign-related enterprises operating in the GBA should map data assets against the list, prioritise the standard contract route for export compliance, and monitor the alignment of data mutual recognition mechanisms among Hong Kong, Macao and the mainland.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong · Nov 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规落地，中国企业的美元基金架构须提前重构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部对外投资审查规则已进入实质执行阶段，涉及半导体、人工智能、量子技术等领域的对华投资须履行申报或禁止义务。中国出海企业若通过美元基金或VIE架构接受美资，应提前审查资金来源与投资领域，评估是否触发申报门槛，并考虑搭建替代性融资架构。建议在交易文件中加入监管变更条款，明确申报义务与退出机制，以降低合规不确定性。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部投资安全办公室 · 2026.11
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: US Outbound Investment Rules Take Effect, Chinese Firms Must Restructure USD Fund Structures Early
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury's outbound investment review rules have entered substantive enforcement, imposing notification or prohibition obligations on China-related investments in semiconductors, AI and quantum technologies. Chinese outbound enterprises receiving US capital through USD funds or VIE structures should review funding sources and investment sectors in advance, assess whether notification thresholds are triggered, and consider alternative financing structures. It is advisable to include regulatory change clauses in transaction documents to clarify notification obligations and exit mechanisms, thereby reducing compliance uncertainty.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Treasury Office of Investment Security · Nov 2026
